title: Replay advisory decisions with a strict scripted driver
narrative: Evaluation and CI need a first-class scripted driver that asserts expected yield kinds and fails when unexpected advice appears. Tracks R-IOC-REPLAY and R-IOC-OFFLINE[^insp-ioc-04].
implementation: `ScriptedDriver` in `durable_graph_generator.py` runs `start`/`resume` loops with fixture responses, optional `expected_kinds`, and `strict_unexpected_advice`.
validation: Harness `durable_graph_generator` op `durable_scripted_replay`. Hard expects unexpected-advice failure when responses are empty under strict mode.
